_doc: Every LCSC part of the dock board (phase 7; selection in reports/phase7/dock-parts.md). scripts/parts/import_lcsc.py --manifest dock-pcb/parts.json builds dock-pcb/parts/<LCSC>/. The dock is assembled on its top side (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, Dock), so every footprint is a top-side one.

parts.role: USB-C receptacle, power only, mid-mount (HRO TYPE-C-31-M-28A): its body sinks into a notch in the board, 1.58 mm above and below its top

fixups.source: Pin-in-paste for the four through-hole shell legs (pads 7-10): the EasyEDA footprint has no paste on them, so reflow wouldn't solder them (the keyboard's C165948 got the same fix, phase 4-6 review M3). Its Edge.Cuts lines (the board's edge and the notch) go: the outline, notch included, comes from dock-pcb/geometry.json, where the tray puts it. The six SMD pads lose 0.14 mm at their front end, toward the notch (1.26 mm long, centre moved back 0.07 mm): HRO's layout puts them 0.16 mm from the notch's end (0.5 mm behind the rear legs), under the 0.3 mm copper to edge rule; the tails solder on the pads' back part, which stays.

parts.model_note: The model's legs on the footprint's slots: in the model, the front legs' centre is 2.80 mm behind the mouth and the rear legs 3.60 mm behind those (HRO's drawing: 6.8 mm body, front legs 4.00 mm from its back)

parts.role: 5.1k CC pull-downs, one per CC pin
